messages:
Samir (support): seeing a surge in 5xx + timeouts from hosted inference since ~09:12 UTC. Customers hitting /v1/generate getting 502/504s and long tail latencies. example curl: `curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -d '{\"input\": \"test\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

DeployBot: ALERT prod-us-east /v1/generate 5xx rate=17% over 5m, backend memcached errors elevated on prefix caches :warning:

Cheng (eng-runtime): looking into cache layer now. memcached pool reporting connection timeouts and "connection reset by peer" on several shards (memc-shard-11..14). Not seeing recent deploys.

Maya (ops): are these the KV/prefix caches (read-through)? any recent config changes to TTLs or replication?

Cheng (eng-runtime): no config deploys. Metrics: prefix-cache miss-rate jumped 6% -> 82% at 09:10, origin RPS up 6x. Logs show repeated hot-read loops and memcached ack timeouts. snippet: ```[2023-09-12T09:11:03Z] memc-client: rpc call failed: connect timeout (10s) shard=memc-shard-12 key="pfx:usr:1234:ctx"```

Lockie (oncall): joining. Oncall runbook steps: 1) flip ff to disable prefix read-through (so requests go to fallback without pressuring cache), 2) restart affected memcached pods, 3) add temporary rate-limit on /v1/generate at edge if needed. I'll coordinate.

Cheng (eng-runtime): disabling read-through now via internal FF API: `curl -X POST https://internal/ff/flags/prefix_readthrough -d '{"enabled":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY"`

Elaine (prod-sre): also scaling memcached proxy and increasing connection pool to reduce queueing: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment memc-proxy --replicas=4` and `kubectl exec -n infra deploy/memc-proxy -- sh -c "sysctl -w net.core.somaxconn=1024"`.

Maya (ops): customer-facing update posted to #support: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx for hosted inference. Temporary mitigation in progress."

Samir (support): after FF disable + proxy scale, 5xx rate dropped to ~2% and p95 latency falling back to baseline. Repro attempt: repeated curl test returns 200 now.

Cheng (eng-runtime): will restart memc-shard-12 pod (evict + recreate) and then run cache warmup job. scheduling restart in 2m.

Lockie (oncall): confirmed mitigation effective. Next: follow-up RCA, add circuit-breaker on prefix cache client, add alert for sustained miss-rate spikes, and a fallback path that doesn't flood origin. I'll own the incident postmortem.

Samir (support): thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll update affected customers and close escalations once postmortem is linked.

Cheng (eng-runtime): filing incident doc and linking runbook + metrics (will post link here).
